Here is a structured schedule for your 4-hour workshop (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM):

node.content-desc: Table with 6 rows and 4 columns. Additional columns are available
Header. Start Time. Duration. Session. Goal
Row 1. Start Time: 9:00 AM. Duration: 30 mins. Session: Welcome & Introductions. Goal: Break the ice, set ground rules, review the day's agenda, and align on core objectives.
Row 2. Start Time: 9:30 AM. Duration: 45 mins. Session: Brainstorming & Ideation. Goal: Generate a wide pool of ideas, identify key challenges, and select top concepts to develop.
Row 3. Start Time: 10:15 AM. Duration: 15 mins. Session: Coffee / Networking Break. Goal: Rest, recharge, and allow informal discussion among participants.
Row 4. Start Time: 10:30 AM. Duration: 75 mins. Session: Hands-on Prototyping. Goal: Translate top ideas into tangible artifacts, mockups, wireframes, or actionable workflows.
Row 5. Start Time: 11:45 AM. Duration: 50 mins. Session: Presentations & Feedback. Goal: Each team/individual presents their prototype; gather constructive peer and facilitator feedback.
Row 6. Start Time: 12:35 PM. Duration: 25 mins. Session: Wrap-up & Next Steps. Goal: Summarize key takeaways, assign action items/ownership, and gather closing feedback.
